_om: Ballongen in English (Up and Away, rusj.no/en/up-and-away/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Hangman without the gallows: a basket under a bunch of balloons; a wrong letter pops one, and the basket has a parachute. The words come from the English word bank (data/kategorier.en); the keyboard is A–Z. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
En figur fra film eller bok: A character from a film or book
Alene eller alle sammen: On your own or all together
Én bokstav hver – flest poeng vinner: One letter each – most points wins
Én lager et hemmelig ord, de andre gjett: One makes a secret word, the others guess
Familiar words – good for the little ones.
Easy words and a few trickier ones.
Lengre og lurere ord – for store og små: Longer, trickier words – for experts big and small.
Fallskjermen tok kurven – myk landing!: The parachute caught the basket – a soft landing!
Phew! The basket landed softly in the grass.
Ingen fare – kurven har fallskjerm!: No harm done – the basket has a parachute!
Myk landing – neste ord klarer dere!: A soft landing – you'll get the next one!
Gjett ordet bokstav for bokstav. Hver fe: Guess the word letter by letter. Every wrong letter pops a balloon – but don't worry: the basket has a parachute!
Finnes den i ordet, dukker den opp. Hvis: If it's in the word, it appears. If not, a balloon pops.
Står dere fast? Hint-knappen viser kateg: Stuck? The hint button shows the category, a clue and, last of all, a letter.
Finn hele ordet før alle ballongene har: Find the whole word before all the balloons have popped. Then the basket sails on!
Begynn med vokaler – A, E, I og O finnes: Start with the vowels – A, E, I and O are in almost every word.
Mot hverandre: én bokstav hver. Hver rik: Against each other: one letter each. Every right letter scores – and whoever finishes the word gets two extra.
Eget ord: den som lager ordet, holder fi: Your own word: whoever makes the word holds a finger on the eye button 👁 to see it. The others look away meanwhile.
Flere ballonger gjør det lettere. Velg 1: More balloons make it easier. Choose 10 when the little ones are playing.
Trykket feil? «Angre» under tastaturet t: Tapped the wrong one? ‘Undo’ under the keyboard takes the letter back – straight afterwards, once per word.
Guess the word letter by letter.
Alle bytter på å lage et hemmelig ord. D: Everyone takes a turn making a secret word. The others guess together.
Hvordan vil dere spille?: How do you want to play?
You take turns choosing one letter each.
The phone goes round – everyone makes a word.
Perfekt når de minste er med!: Perfect when the little ones are playing!
Choose at least one category to start.
Først ut med et hemmelig ord: First up with a secret word
Bare du skal se det. Trykk på bokstavene: Only you should see it. Tap the letters.
Ett ord – eller opptil tre korte ord: One word – or up to three short words
Velg et hint til de andre (valgfritt): Choose a hint for the others (optional)
Hver eneste kurv seilte videre. Godt job: Every single basket sailed on. Well done!
De fleste kurvene seilte videre. Godt jo: Most of the baskets sailed on. Well done!
Noen kurver seilte videre, og resten lan: Some baskets sailed on, and the rest landed softly.
Fallskjermen tok hver eneste kurv. Neste: The parachute caught every single basket. Next time you'll fly!
Ordene trekkes fra kategoriene dere velg: The words are drawn from the categories you choose.
Hint: the word has the letter {b}.
You'll see the result so far.
Hva slags ord er det?: What kind of word is it?
De andre ser dette som det første hintet: The others see this as the first hint.
The word needs at least two letters.
Ordet er klart. Nå gjetter de andre!: The word is ready. Now the others guess!
